response.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS average_loss_rate FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * l / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g >= 53 GROUP BY team_id) AS teams;

assumptions.assumption: A team is identified by team_id across all years and leagues.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat each team in each year and league as a separate team.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS average_loss_rate FROM (SELECT year, league_id, team_id, AVG(1.0 * l / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g >= 53 GROUP BY year, league_id, team_id) AS teams;
